subject: Deployment steward assignments and early risk runbook
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Taylor <jtaylor@elarahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment steward assignments and early risk runbook
Attachments: RW_SOW_Elara_v2.pdf, network_diagram_elara.png

Hi team and Jordan —

Congrats to everyone on getting this over the line. Attaching the latest SOW (v2) and an initial network diagram for Elara Health. High-level summary so CS/implementation can pick up the baton: 

- Committed start: dev sandbox access by 2027-05-05; UAT week target 2027-06-01; go-live target 2027-06-15.
- Deployment mode: Redwood Dedicated (customer-requested isolated pool). Initial capacity commit: equivalent of 4xA10G nodes, targeting 200–300 requests/minute at peak.
- Model / runtime: customer will start on the curated open model (redwood-curated-1) with quantized variant for cost. Expect KV/prefix caching to reduce token usage ~25–35% after warmup.
- Key acceptance gates for go/no-go: sandbox p95 latency <150ms, KV cache hit >=25% on representative traffic, end-to-end functional tests passing, signed SOW/DocuSign completed, network peering complete.
- Compliance/ops asks (open): SOC 2 evidence pack requested by Elara (Jordan), VPC peering window and sidecar routing for telemetry, retention window: customer requests 180 days by default — confirm with Security.

Open items assigned initially: 
- Security questionnaire / evidence: Jordan -> Elara (we need to produce RM evidence).
- Network peering + firewall rules: CS to confirm exact IP ranges; see attached network_diagram_elara.png.
- DocuSign + procurement timeline: Ben to follow up with procurement@elarahealth.com.

Monica/Laura/Karthik — can you confirm owner assignments and any additional preflight items you'd like in a 30-minute preflight call next week? If you prefer, I can schedule the calendar.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Taylor <jtaylor@elarahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Elara Health Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment steward assignments and early risk runbook

Thanks Ben — appreciate the summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) VPC/on-prem: We want the initial Dedicated pool in our VPC (VPC peering). Can Redwood provide the peering window (expected lead time) and whether a private control plane is required for any portion of telemetry?
2) Data retention: Our security team prefers 90–180 days for logs. We also need confirmation that customer data will not be used for model training and that keys are customer-managed (KMS).
3) Sandbox credentials: When you say sandbox by 5/5 — what level of data will be available there? PII-free synthetic or will be able to test with a subset of prod-like data?

I can loop procurement if you want early DocuSign movement, but first we'd like the security/compliance bits answered.

— Jordan
Head of Integrations | Elara Health

Monica/Laura/Karthik — looping you in on Jordan's notes (above). Quick answers from sales side: 

- Peering lead time: typical window is 7–10 business days after we hand over IP ranges and the peering form. We will share the peering template today (Ben).
- Control plane: Redwood Dedicated supports a private control plane option for customers in regulated environments; Elara has requested VPC peering + private control plane as an option (Jordan), so we'll flag this as a security-dependent item.
- Sandbox data: sandbox will initially be PII-free synthetic; we can arrange a staged run with masked subset data for acceptance if Security signs off.
- DocuSign: procurement@elarahealth.com is CC'ed — happy to move the SOW to DocuSign once CS confirms acceptance gates.

Action items (to confirm owners):
- Security evidence / SOC2 pack: Ben to hand off artifacts to Monica for delivery (Ben -> Monica).
- Network peering: Laura to own engineering coordination with Elara's network team.
- Acceptance testing / UAT criteria & test harness: Karthik to draft the test checklist and success criteria.

Can you confirm owners and whether you want an internal-only preflight before bringing Jordan/procurement into a joint call?

Thanks,
Ben

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Re: Deployment steward assignments and early risk runbook

Internal notes / proposed owner assignments (no external recipients):

- Implementation lead (single point): Laura Bennett — will coordinate peering, staging env, and runbooks.
- Technical checklist / acceptance harness: Karthik Iyer — will author the UAT checklist and lead validation.
- Security evidence & compliance pack: Monica Patel — will coordinate with Security/Trust to deliver SOC 2 artifacts and confirm KMS/HSM details.
- PM cadence & comms: Laura to run weekly 30-min syncs with Elara (starting week of 2027-05-10).

Early risks I want on the runbook immediately: 
[ ] Peering blackout windows (Elara has EHR maintenance windows on Sundays 02:00–06:00 PT)
[ ] DocuSign redline on SLA and data retention
[ ] Requirement for private control plane (adds lead time)
[ ] Acceptance traffic shape: need representative sample from Elara by 2027-05-01 to validate KV cache expectations

Next immediate steps (this week):
- Laura: confirm available dates for a 30-min internal preflight with engineering (propose 2027-04-23 or 04-26).
- Karthik: draft UAT checklist (first pass by 2027-04-26).
- Monica: start SOC2 artifact pull and list any follow-ups to security@redwoodinference.com.

I will escalate any SLA or control-plane blockers to Karthik if they would delay the May/June timeline.

— Monica
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Taylor <jtaylor@elarahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Deployment steward assignments and early risk runbook
Attachments: kv_cache_flow.txt

Thanks Ben — and thanks Jordan for the questions. I'll own the implementation and drive the preflight. Quick summary of next steps from CS perspective: 

1) Owners confirmed: Laura (Implementation lead / peering), Karthik (UAT/test harness), Monica (Security pack).
2) Proposed SOW clarifications before DocuSign: add explicit 99.9% uptime SLA for inference endpoints, 30-day acceptance window after UAT, and a clause on KMS-managed keys. Ben — can you flag these to procurement so we can avoid redlines?
3) Acceptance tests (first-pass):
   - Latency: sandbox p95 <150ms under synthetic test load (50% of projected peak).
   - KV cache: sustained cache hit >=25% on representative traffic within 48 hours of warmup.
   - Functional: 10 documented prompt templates exercised end-to-end, pass rate >=95%.

4) Scheduling: internal-only preflight (30 mins) — Thurs 2027-04-26 10:00–10:30 PT (propose). If that works, I'll send an invite and draft the UAT checklist in the same calendar invite.

Procurement / Jordan: once CS confirms the checklist I will share the documented acceptance criteria and we can hand the SOW to DocuSign.

Laid out attachments: kv_cache_flow.txt (small diagram + notes on TTLs and warmup expectations). Also added the HubSpot deal link here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-7890.

I'll update the ticket in our onboarding tracker and assign owners.

— Laura
Senior Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
